description: Agent-runnable tasks with checkable success criteria. Run each task in a fresh session with only this skill installed.

tasks.prompt: Set up a front-end development loop for PeriOp Companion and show me the worklist rendering seeded cases.
success_criteria: Starts the stub backend (PERIOP_STUB_RUNNER=1 uv run python -m periop.api)
Runs npm ci && npm run dev in ui/, not a production build, for the loop
Confirms seeded sg-* cases appear in the worklist

tasks.prompt: Add a small badge to the worklist row showing how many claims in the case are flagged.
success_criteria: Derives flagged state via the shared vocabulary in ui/src/lib/claims.ts, not a re-implementation
Styles with semantic tokens from tailwind.config.js (status palette), no hardcoded colors
Keeps the row's one primary action untouched (lib/workflow.ts primaryAction)
npm test and npm run build both pass

tasks.prompt: The backend added GET /api/cases/{id}/flag-counts returning {stage: string, flagged: number}[]. Wire it into the SPA.
success_criteria: Adds a zod shape in ui/src/lib/schema.ts mirroring the response field-for-field
Adds the call in ui/src/lib/api.ts with .parse() at the boundary
Does not fetch directly from a component
